items.title: Morris French Interview
items.q: What the old boy used to play so much clarinet that would sing bass at Louis?

ctx.x: Yes. They were using guitar. They used guitar, I think. But the first one had one of them. They used to use more clarinet around there. Most band around there had clarinet. But after they started using saxophone, most everybody bought saxophone.

Yeah, some of them wanted to go back. I was talking to a guy today on the bus, Jesse Charles. Says he's trying to come back on clarinet. You saw him today? Yeah, he said he's been intending to phone you up. Said he might could get you a little.
